hero-bullet: Beat the queue when the late-night Korean bank lands — through in 15–20 min
peak-body: Korea is Da Nang's biggest source market, and October gives it two long weekends — 3–5 and 9–11 October. The winter flight schedule starts on the 25th. When two or three flights touch down within the same hour, the Terminal 2 immigration hall fills quickly — 60 to 90 minutes.
faq-night: Most Korean arrivals fall in these hours — seven land 23:15 to midnight. Our service is available 24/7 regardless of flight time.
